title: Preventive Maintenance Agreements — Clearing the Arrears Standing on an Agreement
content:
## Credit control entry

A building owner may clear the arrears standing on their Preventive Maintenance Agreements record in one payment. A payment clearing the arrears on a suspended agreement is taken as one figure against the agreement rather than invoice by invoice. The payment is recorded with today as the day the office received it and lowers the amount owed under the agreement by the amount paid.

### How the payment is made

The agent unlocks the customer's own tool `clear_agreement_arrears_489edb92` and hands it over; the customer themselves runs it. One call books a single payment from the owner against the named agreement, as one figure for the whole account rather than against a named invoice.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `agreement_id` | the reference number of the preventive maintenance agreement record the payment is applied to | an identifier, read from the maintenance agreement lookup before the call |
| `clearance_amount_usd` | the money amount the owner pays to clear the arrears | USD to 2 decimal places, rounded half up at the cent; an amount of zero is accepted and books a zero payment |
| `payment_method` | how the owner sent the money, one of exactly four values | `check` — a paper cheque drawn on the company account, posted or handed over; `ach` — money pushed by bank transfer from the owner's own bank; `credit_card` — the payment put on a company credit card; `wire` — money sent by same-day wire transfer |

### Return

The call returns a one-line confirmation naming the reference number of the payment entry created, the agreement the payment was applied to, the amount paid in USD to two decimal places and the way the money was sent. That line is issued only when the payment has been written and the agreement's outstanding balance has been lowered; it is the owner's receipt of completion.

### Observable effect

Afterwards the payment appears in the agreement's history and the owner can see the agreement's outstanding balance reduced by exactly the amount paid.
